schedule.sessionTitle: Introduction to ICT and Digital Literacy
learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Define digital literacy and ICT correctly by the end of the lesson.
Identify at least 5 uses of computers in daily life and offices.
Explain the importance of ICT skills with 80% accuracy during discussion.
trainerActivities: Demonstrate uses of computers in offices.
traineeActivities: Participate in discussion on ICT use.
Identify areas where computers are used.
Take notes on digital literacy concepts.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Identify at least 10 computer hardware components correctly.
Classify computer devices into input, output, and storage devices accurately.
Describe functions of major computer components with minimal assistance.
trainerActivities: Explain functions of input and output devices.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create and organize folders and files correctly in the computer system.
Demonstrate proper file saving and retrieval procedures.
Explain at least 4 functions of an operating system accurately.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Demonstrate correct keyboard and mouse handling techniques during practical work.
Type simple text with improved speed and accuracy within the session.
Identify keyboard sections and their functions correctly.
trainerActivities: Explain typing posture and mouse handling.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Open, create, save, and close a word processing document successfully.
Identify key parts of the word processor window correctly.
Produce a simple typed document using correct procedures.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Edit text using copy, cut, and paste commands correctly.
Apply text and paragraph formatting tools accurately.
Use spelling and grammar checking tools successfully.
trainerActivities: Demonstrate copy, cut, and paste commands.

schedule.sessionTitle: Tables and Graphics in Word Processing
learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create and format tables in a word document correctly.
Insert and manipulate pictures and shapes successfully.
Format graphical objects to improve document appearance.
trainerActivities: Show insertion of pictures and shapes.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Set document margins and orientation correctly.
Prepare documents for printing using print preview tools.
Print a formatted document successfully by the end of the lesson.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Identify major spreadsheet window components correctly.
Enter and edit data accurately in worksheet cells.
Create and save a workbook successfully.
traineeActivities: Enter and edit data in cells.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Use basic arithmetic formulas correctly in spreadsheets.
Apply spreadsheet functions such as SUM and AVERAGE accurately.
Calculate and present data correctly using formulas.
trainerActivities: Explain functions such as SUM and AVERAGE.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create charts from spreadsheet data correctly.
Label chart elements appropriately.
Interpret information presented in charts accurately.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Format spreadsheet data using borders, alignment, and styles correctly.
Prepare worksheets for printing successfully.
Print formatted worksheets with correct page settings.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Open and create presentation slides successfully.
Insert and organize slide content appropriately.
Save and retrieve presentation files correctly.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Apply themes and layouts to presentation slides correctly.
Format text and slide objects appropriately.
Customize slide appearance to improve presentation quality.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Insert multimedia objects into presentation slides successfully.
Apply slide transitions and animations correctly.
Run and navigate a slide show effectively.
trainerActivities:  Demonstrate insertion of pictures and charts.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create and send emails correctly using an email platform.
Organize and manage email messages effectively.
Demonstrate proper online communication etiquette during activities.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
 Share files using online collaboration platforms successfully.
Collaborate on online documents with other learners effectively.
Participate in virtual meetings using online tools appropriately.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Conduct internet searches using appropriate search terms correctly.
Evaluate online information sources critically.
Perform online data backup procedures successfully
trainerActivities: Guide learners in evaluating information sources.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Identify common cyber security threats correctly.
Apply safe password and data protection practices effectively.
Explain the importance of cyber security laws in Kenya accurately.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create and manage social media accounts successfully.
Adjust privacy and security settings appropriately.
Demonstrate responsible online communication practices.
trainerActivities: Guide learners in responsible online behavior.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Create simple database tables successfully.
Enter and edit records accurately in a database.
Generate simple queries and reports correctly.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Design simple publications using desktop publishing software correctly.
Insert and arrange text and images appropriately.
Apply page layout principles effectively in publication design.
By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Identify different types of computer networks correctly.
Demonstrate simple network connection procedures successfully.
Explain advantages of computer networking accurately.

schedule.sessionTitle: Job Entry and Online Work Skills
learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the learners should be able to:
Prepare a professional CV and cover letter correctly.
Identify suitable online job opportunities successfully.
Demonstrate effective interview and communication skills during mock interviews.
